name: Fake Android Fold adb device
target: Exercise Fold-sized dimensions and the five phone adb operations through a fixed-argv fake boundary, with no adb binary, physical phone, or external network
inputs: fake adb serial and reported Fold screen dimensions
screenshot PNG and UI hierarchy bytes
tap, type and localhost/tailnet URL arguments
observations: screen dimensions are discovered from adb instead of a hardcoded resolution
screenshot and UI hierarchy are returned from the fake device boundary
tap, type and open-url use fixed argv without shell interpolation
the simulator records zero external network attempts
